comment: No source is published. The module declares five parameters but configures only three, indices 2, 0 and 1, so parameters 3 and 4 have no ParamQuantity. Parameter 4 is the GATE MODE switch and does have a ParamWidget on the panel, so it can be clicked but not turned: Rack's Switch ignores a drag when there is no quantity, and paramsToJson skips a parameter without one, so it can never leave zero. Process reads it and dispatches zero to the counted-pulse branch, which is why the gate jack always gives a trigger. Parameter 3 has neither a quantity nor a widget. The panel prints DECAY on the knob whose tooltip says SLEW; the line follows the panel. The follower coefficient is 100 minus nine times that knob, so the knob's range of 0 to 10 gives 100 down to 10 per second. The threshold is squared before the comparison and the knob displays as 40 times the base-ten logarithm, which is the dB scale printed beside the meter. The trigger length is the sample rate times 0.0069999, so 7ms. The meter down the panel is drawn by a custom widget and has no clickable parameter.
